canonical_project: Rogers Capital La Tour Koenig Data Centre
notes: Rogers Capital official page (A) states it operates carrier-neutral data centres in Ebene and La Tour Koenig. Directory evidence places La Tour Koenig at Informatics Park, 36 Andreanum Ave, Port Louis (C); the La Tour Koenig district is part of Port Louis, so assigned there per methodology boundary. Capacity not disclosed.
